correctness.rationale: All 3100 and 16758 geometrically smooth conics were exhaustively enumerated up to scalar over F5,F7. The exact polar determinant smoothness criterion, projective transitivity on conics, all-lines bitset cover, 120-element stabilizer orbit check and independent NumPy cross-check establish 18600 in one orbit for q=5 and zero for q=7. Exact standalone programs are included.

value.rationale: Joint classification provides a sharp first tested odd-prime-field obstruction in a natural algebraic blocking-curve construction, uniquely classifies the exceptional q=5 conic-pair orbit, its incidence line spectrum, and identifies a threshold that motivates stronger general external-line incidence theorems. The known q=3 classification neither implies the q=5 orbit nor q=7 exclusion.
